title: Three Scary Story Advertisements
passage: The Less You Know. The new neighbor moves into the house next door. Helpful and polite, he soon makes friends with everyone on the street. But when 17-year-old Talah disappears, people start to get concerned. Who is the new neighbor really? Where did he come from? Maybe the less you know, the better. The Voice from Beyond. As you lie sleeping, safe in your bed, you are suddenly woken by a strange noise. It seems to be coming from outside your window. Is it the wind? Or is it just the rain on the roof? Or is somebody softly calling your name? One thing is certain: you will never sleep easily again. Don't Talk to Strangers. On a freezing winter night, there is a knock on the door. An old man stands in front of you, asking to come in from the cold. Feeling sorry for him, you invite the visitor in. What happens next will have you shaking in your boots. Are you brave enough to turn the page?
